title: String patterns — capitalize, reverse, count vowels
hints: Capitalize: charAt(0).toUpperCase() + slice(1) se pehla letter bada aur baaki same
Reverse: split("") se array banao, reverse() karo, join("") se wapas string banao
Vowels count: regex /[aeiouAEIOU]/g se saare vowels match karo, .length se count lo
